description.en: Live token stats band for DeepSeek Harness: tokenises the model's streaming output with the bundled official DeepSeek V4 BPE table and renders stream TPS, output tokens, stall time and time-to-first-token under the composer, then reconciles the estimate against the provider usage once the step settles. Pure plugin, no DSH source changes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的实时 token 状态带：用内置的 DeepSeek 官方 V4 BPE 分词表对模型流式输出实时分词，在 composer 下方渲染流式 TPS、输出 token、已停顿时长与首字延迟，step 结算后再把估算与官方 usage 对账。纯插件自包含，不改 DSH 源码。
